note: Props for procedural missions, random station stock and loot (Abe, 2026-09-26): items that fit the world and can be used as one-offs. Icons come from two 5 x 5 sheets made in ChatGPT (docs/image_needs.json: props_supplies, props_story); cell = [column, row]. Tags help a mission pick a fitting prop (medical, life_support, fuel, mining, contraband, valuable, fragile, story, relief, science). Names and descriptions are English text for now; art has no words.

items.name: Compressed O2 Canister
items.description: Ten litres of breathable oxygen under pressure.

items.name: CO2 Scrubber Cartridge
items.description: Keeps a hab's air breathable. They always run out faster than planned.

items.name: Water Purification Unit
items.description: Turns melted ice into something you'd drink.

items.name: Hydrogen Fuel Canister
items.description: Refined hydrogen, sealed for transport.

items.name: Fuel Block
items.description: Station generator fuel. Too unstable for a jump drive.

items.name: Medical Supply Crate
items.description: Bandages, stims, and the good painkillers.

items.name: Vaccine Cooler
items.description: Keep it cold, keep it upright, keep it moving.

items.name: Ration Crate
items.description: A month of meals nobody will enjoy.

items.name: Hydroponic Seed Vault
items.description: Next season's crops, sealed against vacuum.

items.name: Filter Pack
items.description: Spare filters for air and water systems.

items.name: Radiation Suit
items.description: Heavy, hot, and the reason someone is still alive.

items.name: Reactor Coolant Drum
items.description: Keeps a reactor from becoming a very short story.

items.name: Portable Generator
items.description: Emergency power for a place that has run out of it.

items.name: Airlock Seal Kit

items.name: Thermal Blanket Bundle
items.description: Foil blankets for when the heat goes out.

items.name: Emergency Beacon
items.description: Shouts for help on every band until someone answers.

items.name: Life-Support Control Board
items.description: The brain of a hab's air system.

items.name: Solar Panel Patch
items.description: Replacement cells for a damaged array.

items.name: Mining Charge
items.description: Shaped explosive for cracking stubborn rock.

items.name: Drill Head
items.description: A diamond-tipped bit for a mining rig.

items.name: Ore Sample Case
items.description: Labelled rock, for someone who pays to know what's in the belt.

items.name: Ice Core Tube

items.name: Atmosphere Sensor
items.description: Tells you what you're breathing before it's too late.

items.name: Portable Stasis Pod
items.description: Keeps something, or someone, exactly as it was.

items.name: Worn Duffel Bag
items.description: Everything a family could carry when they left.

items.name: Sealed Evidence Tube
items.description: Tamper tape on both ends. Someone wants this in front of a tribunal.

items.name: Forged Manifest Slate
items.description: Says the cargo is something it isn't.

items.name: Transponder Chip
items.description: A ship's identity on a sliver of silicon.

items.name: Sealed Ballot Cache
items.description: Votes, locked and counted. For now.

items.name: Seal of Office
items.description: Whoever holds it gives the orders. In theory.

items.name: Gate-Cult Idol

items.name: Ghost-Fleet Flight Log

items.name: Caged AI Core

items.name: Unlicensed Reactor Seed

items.name: Weapon Crate, Serials Burned
items.description: Whatever's inside, nobody wants it traced.

items.name: Counterfeit Credit Chips
items.description: Good enough to spend once. Not twice.

items.name: Vintage Wine Crate
items.description: Grown on a world that isn't there any more.

items.name: Artwork Tube
items.description: A rolled canvas someone would kill to hang.

items.name: Heirloom Music Box
items.description: It still plays. Barely.

items.name: Diplomatic Pouch
items.description: Sealed, stamped, and not yours to open.

items.name: Bounty Warrant Chip
items.description: A name, a price, and a signature.

items.name: Restraint Collar
items.description: Made for someone who didn't want to come quietly.

items.name: Cracked Star Chart
items.description: An old route map, split down the middle. Someone has the other half.

items.name: Derelict Ship's Bell

items.name: Stolen Targeting Core

items.name: Biohazard Flask

items.name: Terraforming Seed Canister
